# Delivery planning

Use one integrated implementation child by default; the existing parent coordinates. Select executionProfile `{system:"nestos-work-delivery",id:"release"|"source"|"verification",revision:"1"}` on EVERY child, not a string/externalRefs substitute.

Add source children only for independent delivery, approval, cross-project ownership or substantial safe parallelism. Each needs splitJustification (30–2000 characters) explaining benefit over extra handoff/integration, and must precede the single integration child. Complexity, duration, file/package counts and implementation checklists alone do not justify splitting. Do not create coordination siblings, readiness placeholders or build/deploy tasks.

Default: one release-profile implementation (depends on all extra source children), then one independent read-only verification child directly depending on release. Implementation owns files, internal planning/checks/commits in one Session/worktree. Verification consumes the frozen release evidence/exact running version without edits, rebuilding or deployment; real defects require an approved repair. Host lifecycle owns build, replacement, submission and cleanup.

# Delivery planning

Use one integrated implementation child by default; the existing parent coordinates. Select executionProfile `{system:"nestos-work-delivery",id:"release"|"source"|"verification",revision:"1"}` on EVERY child, not a string/externalRefs substitute.

Add source children only for independent delivery, approval, cross-project ownership or substantial safe parallelism. Each needs splitJustification (30–2000 characters) explaining benefit over extra handoff/integration, and must precede the single integration child. Complexity, duration, file/package counts and implementation checklists alone do not justify splitting. Do not create coordination siblings, readiness placeholders or build/deploy tasks.

Follow frozen verificationLevel/deliveryMode; automation is default:
- full+release: release implementation, then exactly one read-only verification child directly depending on it.
- quick+release: one release implementation, focused checks in its Session, no independent verifier.
- none+release: one release implementation; host builds/replaces/integrates/cleans, without optional functional verification.
- none+build: one release implementation; build then manual review, no automatic replacement/integration/cleanup.
- none+source: source implementation without build/replacement; host integrates and cleans after approval.
No other combination is valid. These choices override default verification shape, not authorization, artifact integrity, startup health, conflict confirmation or resource safety. Report skipped checks as skipped. Host follows build → replace → accept → submit; submit includes analysis, confirmed Git integration and cleanup with retained Session history. Waivers/cancellation follow formal linked host receipts; never replay unknown operations.
